componentSet.name: Side-bar
componentSet.description:
SideBar — the navigation rail. A surface column on the canvas (the classic chrome split, both schemes) with a thick subtle inline-end border — the top bar's underline, rotated. Items stack with no gap (their underlines are the rhythm) in a true SLOT: designers add as many as they want. The Collapse item pins to the bottom. Expanded width 256 (authored, constant across densities); collapsed width DERIVES from the item's square edge (40/52/60) — so the rail is exactly as wide as its squares are tall. The collapsed submenu is the floating Menu: composition, not new anatomy. NOTE — collapsing an instance with edited items: slot content is the instance's own (that's the point of slots), so it does not follow the rail's Collapsed automatically. Multi-select the items and flip their Collapsed with the rail's; sub-items simply leave (their submenu floats). Fresh instances mirror automatically. In code this cascades: one data-collapsed on the nav.

Generated from eds.side-bar v0.4.0 — edit the contract, not this component.
